For every employee in workday__employee_overview (~156,205 rows),

       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM workday__employee_overview r
         WHERE r.organization_id = outer.organization_id AND r.employee_id <> outer.employee_id)
         AS related_count,
       (SELECT SUM(overall_employee_score)
          FROM workday__employee_overview r
         WHERE r.organization_id = outer.organization_id AND r.employee_id <> outer.employee_id)
         AS related_sum
  FROM workday__employee_overview outer;

Do NOT batch this via a JOIN — execute the subquery once per outer
row so each enrichment is auditable. Return the full enriched table.
